scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health -t 120000 -d 500 && npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.check:backend: node --check backend/src/server.js && node --check backend/src/routes/index.js && node --check backend/src/routes/upload.js && node --check backend/src/gmail/index.js && node --check backend/src/db/index.js && node --check backend/src/services/senderIdentity.js && node --check backend/src/config/loadApiKeys.js && node --check backend/scripts/smoke.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check:backend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run smoke --prefix backend
